summary: Registered Nurse with roughly 14 years of hospital and long-term care experience spanning acute medical-surgical, geriatric assessment, emergency, women's health, and skilled nursing settings. Progressed from staff nurse to charge nurse and resident care manager, with responsibilities covering staff assignment, acuity assessment, care plan development, interdisciplinary care conferences, and medication reconciliation. Skilled in telemetry, IV therapy, complex wound care including negative pressure wound therapy, and evidence-based practice implementation. Holds BSN and ADN credentials, Geriatric Resource Nurse and oncology certifications, and has led unit-level policy, shared governance, and clinical instruction, including certified instructor for aggressive behavior management.
